Awesome Possum Kicks Dr. Machino's Butt!.summary: Awesome Possum Kicks Dr. Machino's Butt is an action platformer with gameplay very similar to the Sonic games. The possum can jump and run very quickly, as well as spin to hurt enemies and breeze through levels. Various robotic creatures will try to kill you during your journey to Dr. Machino’s lair, and you can either avoid them or try to defeat them as you go.
